title: HR Business Partner
must_have: 3+ years of experience in human resources
text:
HR Business Partner
Chambal Manufacturing | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a hr business partner to join our human resources team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Employee Engagement
- Talent Acquisition
- Onboarding
- Performance Management
- Compensation Benchmarking
- 3+ years of experience in human resources

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- HRIS
- Stakeholder Management
- Labour Law Compliance
- Employer Branding

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive attrition review with measurable outcomes.
- Drive wellness initiative with measurable outcomes.
- Drive campus recruitment drive with measurable outcomes.
